title: Document Version Manifest
description: Version manifest for drafted documents in the litigation workflow. Enforces no-overwrite: each revision creates a new version entry with its own hash and metadata.

generated.description: ISO 8601 date when this manifest snapshot was generated.

document_id.description: Stable identifier shared across all versions of the same document (e.g., DOC-CASE666234B709-NOTICE-001). All versions of the same document share this ID.

version.description: Sequential version number starting at 1. No skipping permitted.

case_id.description: Parent case identifier — must match the manifest's case_id.

filename.description: Exact filename including version suffix (e.g., Notice_v1.pdf, CasePacket_v3.pdf). Must include _v{N} suffix.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex hash of this version of the document, computed at time of creation.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this version was created. Null for planned future versions.

created_by.description: Name or system identifier of the author. Null for planned future versions.

supersedes_version.description: Version number of the prior version this version supersedes. Null for version 1.

status.description: draft = being authored; pending_approval = awaiting human approval; approved = approved for use; submitted = externally transmitted (immutable); superseded = replaced by a newer version; archived = retained for record, no longer active.

notes.description: Description of changes from the prior version, or rationale for this version.
